title: Concord recorded-law coverage manifest
description: Closed contract for the record of how each piece of recorded law is proved. The subject set is docs/concord-knowledge-index.v1.json, not this file: scripts/check-law-coverage.py derives the complete set of indexed records and fails on any record this manifest omits, so law cannot escape coverage by being absent (CD-0047 D1). States reuse the vocabulary accepted in contracts/floor-readiness.schema.json (CD-0047 D2). A satisfied record cites typed anchors that resolve and, where executable, that a required check runs; a repository path is not an anchor (CD-0047 D3).

source.description: The manifest whose records define this manifest's subject set. The coverage record never decides what counts as law; it only declares how known law is proved.

id.description: A record id from the knowledge index, such as CD-0014 or a spec id.

state.description: satisfied: the record is proved by the cited anchors. outstanding: it should be proved and is not, tracked by an issue. unmeasured: coverage has not been assessed. out_of_scope: the record is deliberately not proved by executable evidence. Prose-only law stays legal when it is declared prose-only; the failure mode is the undeclared case.

evidence.description: Typed anchors proving a satisfied record. Required when satisfied; forbidden otherwise.

kind.description: go_test: <package>.<TestName>, executed by the required go test ./... step. scenario: an id declared by a corpus under scenarios/ and bound to a driver; a deferred scenario is executed by nothing and is refused. validator: a scripts/check-*.py that .github/workflows/ci.yml invokes, directly or nested through check-json.py. generated: <path>#<symbol> in an artifact carrying the generator marker.

issue.description: Public issue tracking an outstanding record. Required when outstanding; forbidden otherwise.

reason.description: Why a record is unmeasured or out of scope. Required for those states; forbidden otherwise.
